# CardActionsAlign

`Flare.Components.CardActionsAlign`

Alignment of FlareCardActions content along the row (or column, when vertical).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Start` | `0` | Align actions to the start (left in LTR). |
| `Center` | `1` | Center the actions. |
| `End` | `2` | Align actions to the end (right in LTR). |
| `Between` | `3` | Distribute actions with space between them. |
| `Stretch` | `4` | Stretch the actions to fill the row, sharing the width equally. |

## Used by components

- `FlareCardActions`
